concerns.text: The plan generates the ground‑truth `task_success` label by sampling from a logistic model that directly uses the three topology predictors (widget_depth, branching_factor, graph_connectivity) plus noise. This makes the validation of topology‑predictive power circular: the outcome is defined as a function of the predictors, so any model trained on these features is guaranteed (up to noise) to achieve the claimed performance. Consequently the AUC‑ROC / Brier‑score evaluation cannot provide empirical evidence that topology alone explains transfer success; the result is true by construction rather than by independent observation.
